name: El Toro Viejo (Logan, UT) Soft Corn Tortilla Carne Asada Tacos (Cilantro & Rice)
whyItWorks: Grilled marinated skirt steak served inside soft warm corn tortillas with Spanish rice. Unbreaded, lean, high in iron, and gentle when omitting raw diced onions.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Carne Asada Tacos with soft corn tortillas and Spanish rice (hold raw diced onions and spicy red salsa).
